symptoms: High osmolar gap, severe high anion gap metabolic acidosis
Visual disturbances/blindness (Methanol), acute renal failure/oxalate crystals (Ethylene glycol)

management_steps.details: Fomepizole 15mg/kg loading, then 10mg/kg q12h OR 40% Ethanol (Vodka) 1.5-2 ml/kg loading dose, then 0.3 ml/kg/hr via NGT.

NaHCO3 8.5%: 1ml/kg IV for pH < 7.2.
Ethylene glycol cofactors: Pyridoxine 100mg QID + Thiamine 100mg QID.
Methanol cofactors: Folic acid 50mg q4-6h.
